We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. But we could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. However we need the compound identity. No input data provided. Possibly the system expects us to request IR spectra which will show carbonyl peaks. But we need count of C=O groups. IR will show peaks around 1700 cm-1. Could count number of distinct carbonyl peaks. Might be ambiguous.

Better to get carbon NMR: carbonyl carbons appear around 190-210 ppm. Count distinct signals.

We need to minimize cost. Use carbon_nmr_spectra first. Then interpret.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
